methodology.fidelity: full = full stream, core sport inputs and valid positioned WP when provided; partial = missing core inputs/WP; generic = scoring-only stream. Full does not certify all live information.
limitations: Football timeout balances are unavailable unless explicitly captured; no balances are inferred from timeout events.
MLB sparse bases use the captured at-bat schema; provider outs/count values are replayed as recorded, including retrospective inconsistencies.
Only checkpoint-local basketball control events establish possession; shot/foul team IDs do not.
NHL play strength cannot establish historical skater counts or goalie presence.
Static context/records are retained from the fixture; final statistics, line scores, winners and current-drive outcomes are excluded from the primary view.
methodology.coverageRule: At least 5 replayed games, 30 states and 30 full states; a warning heuristic, not statistical sufficiency.
methodology.groups: Specific and decisive groups may overlap. Neutral means no observed situation award or decisive condition; partial neutral states may hide unobserved leverage.
methodology.weighting: Checkpoint-weighted; consecutive states from one game are correlated, not independent observations.
